**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make push scheduling fail-soft after local mutation commit**

In the local-first path, records and changelog entries are persisted before this `await schedulePush()` call, so a transient native bridge failure during scheduling (via `createNativeSyncController.schedulePush -> requestBridgeMethod`) will reject `client.mutate()` even though the mutation already succeeded locally. That false failure encourages retries that can duplicate/conflict with already-committed mutations, so scheduling should not be allowed to flip a committed mutation into an error result.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce iCloud remote-only rejection for batch queries**

This iCloud guard is only executed in the single-query branch; batch queries return earlier through the `Array.isArray(normalizedQuery)` path and are forwarded to `remote.query` without checking whether any resource is `isRemoteOnly`. As a result, `client.query([{ resource: "auditLogs", ... }])` can bypass the intended iCloud restriction while the equivalent single query is rejected, leading to inconsistent and unsupported behavior.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+        guard event.name == DatafnCoreDataStore.storageChangedEvent else {

+            return

+        guard let searchFields = searchFieldsByResource[resource] else {
+            return

+        let ids = event.payload["ids"]?.arrayValue?.compactMap(\.stringValue) ?? []
+        guard !ids.isEmpty else {
+            return
+        }
+
+        lock.lock()
+        pendingOperations += 1
+        lock.unlock()
+
+        Task { [store, searchBackend] in
+            defer { self.finishOperation() }

+            var upserts: [DatafnSearchDocument] = []
+            var deletions: [DatafnSearchDocument] = []

+                if let record = try? store.getRecord(resource: resource, id: id),
+                   let document = makeSearchDocument(record: record, fields: searchFields)

+---
+title: Getting Started with Swift
+description: Build local Swift search with the standalone SearchFn Swift package.
+---
+
+SearchFn Swift is a standalone Swift Package Manager package for local search in native Apple apps and other Swift runtimes where in-process or SQLite-backed search is the right fit.
+
+It ships:
+
+- `SearchFnCore` for tokenization, prefix indexing, fuzzy expansion, and BM25-style scoring
+- `SearchFnMemoryAdapter` for ephemeral in-process search
+- `SearchFnSQLiteAdapter` for persisted SearchFn-owned local indexes
+- `SearchFnClient` for validation and deterministic `searchAll`
+- `SearchFnConvenience` for `InMemorySearchFn` and `SearchFn(sqlite:)`
+
+## Build From Repo Root
+
+```bash
+swift test --package-path searchfn/swift
+swift build --package-path searchfn/swift --target SearchFnInMemoryExample
+swift build --package-path searchfn/swift --target SearchFnSQLiteExample
+```
+
+## In-Memory Example
+
+```swift
+import SearchFnAdapterContracts
+import SearchFnConvenience
+
+let search = InMemorySearchFn(
+    defaults: SearchFnDefaults(limit: 20, limitPerResource: 10, fuzzy: .enabled, prefix: true)
+)
+
+let client = search.client()
+
+try await client.initialize(
+    SearchFnInitializeParams(
+        resources: [
+            SearchFnInitializeResourceConfig(name: "tasks", searchFields: ["title", "body"])
+        ]
+    )
+)
+
+try await client.index(
+    SearchFnIndexParams(
+        resource: "tasks",
+        documents: [
+            SearchFnDocument(id: "t1", fields: ["title": "Hybrid search", "body": "Swift local index"]),
+            SearchFnDocument(id: "t2", fields: ["title": "Groceries", "body": "Milk and bread"])
+        ]
+    )
+)
+
+let ids = try await client.search(
+    SearchFnSearchParams(resource: "tasks", query: "hybrid")
+)
+```
+
+## SQLite Example
+
+```swift
+import Foundation
+import SearchFnAdapterContracts
+import SearchFnConvenience
+import SearchFnSQLiteAdapter
+
+let rootURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
+    .appendingPathComponent("searchfn-swift-demo", isDirectory: true)
+
+let search = try SearchFn(
+    sqlite: SearchFnSQLiteAdapterConfiguration(
+        rootURL: rootURL,
+        indexKey: "project-docs"
+    )
+)
+
+let client = search.client()
+```
+
+The SQLite adapter owns its persisted index state. The store layout is:
+
+```text
+<rootURL>/<slug(indexKey)>-<hash16(indexKey)>/
+  searchfn.sqlite
+  manifest.json
+```
+
+This is SearchFn-owned persistence, not Core Data-owned persistence.
+

+                let requiredEntities = Set(self.resourceEntities.values)
